coverage: Copy and restore scan all metadata pages before body reads or destination writes.
Final-page metadata faults cover 5 GiB plus one byte, negative and fractional sizes, NaN, Infinity and an unsafe integer.
All metadata-fault cases assert zero GETs and PUTs and an empty destination.
Transfer rechecks listed and fetched size and retains conditional-create PUT and streamed readback.
Existing native copy/resume, full namespace recovery and coordinator process-death tests remain passing.
limits: Metadata fault injection does not demonstrate a real 5 GiB upload.
Objects above 5 GiB remain unsupported by the conditional single-PUT transfer path; multipart transfer is not implemented.
Preflight adds a full metadata listing pass and still requires externally isolated writers.
Production-scale transfer, deployed platform limits and multipart no-overwrite semantics remain open.
